prompt_en: A detailed summer fashion photograph catches one coordinated summer moment at an outdoor salt-water pool: a careful handover of recovered ceramic tiles from the water to the dry stone deck. The foreground woman stands on a broad shallow submerged step, with the water just below her ankles and both bare feet planted apart. Her visible face and hair draw on the supplied portrait: a chin-length dark bob, lightly separated fringe, dark eyes, gently curved brows, softly rounded cheeks and natural pink lips. Her face remains particular to that reference as she turns an easy returning smile toward her friend. The foreground woman wears an apricot halter tankini top with broad fabric straps rising beside her neck. Its torso-length bodice ends at a straight independent lower hem just above the waist. Sea-green high-rise swim briefs form a separate lower garment, with a distinct waistband at her natural waist and two separate leg openings outlining her upper thighs. A slim uninterrupted strip of bare skin remains visible between the tankini hem and the briefs waistband. A cropped pale ivory linen cover-up shirt lies over her shoulders, short sleeves softly folded, the unbuttoned front panels falling away from the tankini front and its lower edge. The foreground woman's cropped linen cover-up is the short outer top: its front-panel and side hems terminate at the lower ribcage. That short shirt hem lies close above her separately worn high-rise swim-briefs waistband, while the apricot tankini remains an independently visible layer between the linen and the waist. Sun passes through the fine linen weave while the denser swim fabric holds its own matte color. She cradles the underside of a small slotted wooden tray with both palms, her elbows softly bent, extending it to her left toward the dry deck at lower-chest height. The tray stays beside her torso, leaving the central bodice, separate waist edges and upper-thigh garment boundaries visible. Four blue-and-white glazed tiles lie flat inside, still wet, with drops falling from the slots. Her friend kneels on the deck at frame right, back turned three-quarter toward the viewer, one knee and the opposite planted foot supporting her as she leans toward the tray. One receiving hand grips the far rim while the other braces on the deck. The friend wears a charcoal one-piece swimsuit: two straps pass over her shoulders and join the upper-back fabric edge, and one continuous back panel extends through the waist to the seat before dividing into two leg openings. Her hair is gathered high enough to expose that strap-to-panel connection. A tipped empty tile carrier rests on the pool step, and a fresh narrow drip trail leads toward a folded towel waiting on the dry deck. These traces make the brief shared recovery understandable. The pale stone, cool green water and warm apricot fabric organize attention from the foreground face to the carrying hands, then to the rear-view swimsuit and the wet tiles. Photograph from a modest standing viewpoint across the shallow end, with a wide horizontal frame including both people, the foreground woman's feet and the friend's knee and planted foot. Gentle afternoon sun and water-reflected light preserve natural skin, linen folds, wet wood and the distinct garment edges in an inhabited summer lifestyle photograph. The foreground woman's face stays clearly readable at this viewing distance. The carrying palms and the receiving hand's contact with the tray rim remain individually recognizable. The stone pool-step edge is a recognizable place cue for this outdoor pool setting. The far pool wall falls gently out of focus.
